<ce> The lesser one is ash, and %vam saw it done.
<ce> Will you take the ring that marks you as one
<ce> of us, %pcf - or bind yourself to the family
<ce> in blood?

Message:  1901
Take the ring of %vam.

Message:  1902
Swear the blood-oath instead.

Message:  1903
<ce> Excellent, %pcf. You'll make a fine member
<ce> of %vam. Welcome to the family. I am known
<ce> as _questgiver_. %vam will continue to watch
<ce> your progress, and we may contact you from
<ce> time to time on family business. Your oath
<ce> is sworn, and the blood remembers.
